notes: life-story spec, Life_Story_File. Drafted by Claude Code on 2026-11-24; approved by the user on 2026-11-24 (「草稿核准」) in both languages (life-story Requirement 1.2). Selection (design, 'Story and Ending'): the line of the quarter's Life_Event or Application result first, then the largest difference between the versions, then the situation; within a group the first template whose condition holds is used. Story text describes what happens and the comparison with real history, never a verdict (neutrality.md). housing-tools task 4.2: the sublease texts, approved by the user on 2026-11-25 (「草稿核准，30% 可以」).
